chương trình thạc sĩ logistics và quản l: The Master's program in Logistics and Supply Chain Management at Van Lang develops in-depth knowledge of operations management, analysis and improvement of logistics operations. Students approach the supply chain as a system, thereby improving their ability to identify problems, design solutions and support decisions in practice.
nền tảng chung kết hợp phương pháp nghiê: The shared foundation combines research methods with systems engineering, engineering economics, operations research, industrial statistics and quality management. Specialist courses cover procurement, transportation, inventory, lean management, information systems and management tools; compulsory and elective requirements differ by track.
cả hai định hướng đều có khối lượng 60 t: Both tracks carry a load of 60 credits. The the applied track connects learning with a 6-credit graduation internship and a 9-credit capstone project. The the research track spends 12 credits for two topics on Supply Chain Management and 15 credits for the thesis, supporting students to delve deeper into a professional issue.

hai định hướng ứng dụng và nghiên cứu kh: How Do the Applied and Research Tracks Differ?
cả hai định hướng đều có 60 tín chỉ. hướ: Both tracks are 60 credits. The applied track to develop management capacity, administration and improvement of logistics activities, with a 6-credit graduation internship and a 9-credit capstone project. The research track to develop independent research and analysis capacity, with two Supply Chain Management topics, each 6 credits, and a thesis of 15 credits.
thời gian học và lịch học được bố trí nh: How are class times and schedules arranged?
thời gian đào tạo chuẩn là 18 tháng đối: The standard program duration is 18 months for the applied track and 24 months for the research track. Class schedules are arranged on weekday evenings and/or Saturdays and Sundays according to each semester's schedule. The official timetable is announced by the University.
định hướng nghiên cứu có điều kiện dự tu: Does the research track have separate entry requirements?
ngoài các điều kiện dự tuyển chung, ứng: In addition to the general entry requirements, research-track applicants must hold a bachelor's degree classified as Good or above and have relevant research publications. Admission to both tracks is based on application assessment.
học phần tự chọn của hai định hướng được: How are the elective courses of the two tracks selected?
cả hai định hướng đều tích lũy 12 tín ch: Both tracks accumulate 12 specialized elective credits. The applied track choose 4 out of 6 modules; the research track choose 4 out of 10 modules. Each course has 3 credits. Registration and class opening are carried out according to the Faculty's academic plan.
tốt nghiệp ngành khác có thể dự tuyển kh: Can I apply if I have graduated from another major?
người tốt nghiệp các ngành logistics và: Graduates in Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Industrial Systems Engineering or Industrial Management are exempt from bridging courses. Other applications are reviewed to assess eligibility and determine bridging requirements of up to 6 credits. Applicants must still meet the requirements for their chosen track and language of instruction.
yêu cầu ngoại ngữ của chương trình tiếng: Are the foreign language requirements of the Vietnamese and English programs different?
với chương trình bằng tiếng việt, ứng vi: With the program in Vietnamese, candidates must meet the foreign language entry proficiency equivalent to Level 3/6 or higher according to recognized forms. For programs in English, entry requirements are equivalent to Level 4/6 or higher or a recognized diploma according to the University's regulations. Foreign language graduation requirements equivalent to Level 4/6 or higher must be achieved before graduation.
học phí toàn khóa được xác định theo địn: Is total program tuition determined by orientation or language?
học phí được công bố theo ngôn ngữ đào t: Tuition fees are announced by language of instruction: VND 85,000,000 for programs in Vietnamese and VND 175,000,000 for programs in English.
